label: Bible Study
prompt: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without _____.
verse: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
note: God's open invitation to the thirsty — come buy wine and milk, and bring no money.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a _____, which is Christ the Lord.
verse: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
note: The angel's birth announcement to the shepherds — the KJV spells it 'Saviour,' British-style, with a 'u.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a _____ to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verse: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
note: A camel through a needle's eye — Jesus' deliberately absurd picture, and the disciples were exceedingly amazed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to _____ God rather than men.
verse: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
note: Arrested again and ordered to stop preaching, the apostles explained the chain of command to the council.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my _____ are kindled together.
verse: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
note: God's heart turns within him over Ephraim — 'my repentings are kindled together.' Love wrestling with justice.
